step1_analysis.description: A fully differential pre-amplifier for a SAR ADC comparator. It features a cross-coupled NMOS tail for positive feedback (gain enhancement) and a PMOS capacitive neutralization network to reduce kickback noise and improve stability.

paper_reference.title: 9.9 A 2.72fJ/conv 13b 2MS/s SAR ADC Using Dynamic Capacitive Comparator with Wide Input Common Mode

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain is enhanced by the cross-coupled NMOS pair. gm_in ~ 1mS, R_out ~ 100kOhm due to partial cancellation of output conductance. Gain = gm * R_out ~ 100 V/V = 40dB. Can be higher if perfectly tuned.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the exact matching of the cross-coupled pair's negative resistance and the load's positive resistance.

sky130_expected.calculation: f3db = 1 / (2 * pi * R_out * C_load). With R_out ~ 100kOhm and C_load ~ 10fF + parasitic (~20fF total), f3db ~ 80MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth trades off with the high DC gain achieved via positive feedback.

sky130_expected.calculation: Two tail current sources (M1, M5) with W/L=5u/0.5u at Vgs=0.9V. Id ~ 310uA each. Total current ~ 620uA. Power = 620uA * 1.8V = 1.1mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square law for SKY130 NMOS at 0.9V bias.

delay.description: Propagation delay for a small differential input step

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay ~ 0.69 * R_out * C_load. With R_out ~ 100kOhm and C_total ~ 20fF, delay ~ 1.4ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High gain pre-amplifiers with positive feedback typically have longer delays due to the high output impedance.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, bandwidth, power, and transient delay of the pre-amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Pre-amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

XM1 N8 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N8 N5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N7 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 N3 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N7 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N5 N1 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N5 N0 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N6 N5 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N2 N1 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N4 LABEL_NET_2 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N6 N3 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N4 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N2 N4 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N5 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VN0 N0 0 0.9

* Inputs: N3 (INP), N1 (INN)
VINP N3 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5 pulse(0.85 0.95 1n 10p 10p 10n 20n)
VINN N1 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5 pulse(0.95 0.85 1n 10p 10p 10n 20n)

* Load capacitors
Cload1 N4 0 10f
Cload2 N5 0 10f

* Dependent sources for differential signals
B_diff_in diff_in 0 V=v(N3)-v(N1)
B_diff_out diff_out 0 V=v(N5)-v(N4)

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1 10G
let gain_mag = mag(v(diff_out))
let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac f3db when gain_db='dc_gain - 3' fall=1

tran 10p 5n
meas tran delay trig v(diff_in) val=0 rise=1 targ v(diff_out) val=0 rise=1

quit
.endc
